Delete a Salary Structure Type

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to delete a structure type that has no salary structures.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Structure Types

Click Structure Types.

4. Find the structure type

Type the name of the structure type and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the structure type.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Delete

Click Delete.

8. Confirm

Click Delete in the window to confirm.
